document.lead: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.

text: Few technologies have caused as much excitement and anxiety as artificial intelligence (AI), which can now write texts, analyse data and even help to diagnose diseases. This essay will discuss both the optimistic and the pessimistic views of its impact on employment before arguing that the outcome depends largely on how societies manage the change.

Optimists argue that AI will follow the pattern of earlier technological revolutions. When machines replaced most farm workers in the twentieth century, entirely new industries emerged and overall employment grew. Similarly, AI is already creating demand for data specialists, software engineers and people who train and supervise automated systems. Furthermore, by taking over repetitive tasks, it may free workers to focus on creative and interpersonal work that machines cannot do well.

Pessimists, by contrast, point out that this revolution differs from earlier ones in speed and scope. Previous machines mainly replaced physical labour, whereas AI can perform tasks once reserved for educated professionals, such as translators, accountants and customer service staff. Even if new jobs appear, they may require skills that displaced workers do not have, and they may be created in different countries from those where jobs are lost.

In my view, both sides are partly right. In the long term, AI is likely to create new types of work, but the transition could be painful for millions of people. Governments and employers therefore need to invest heavily in retraining, particularly for mid-career workers, so that the benefits of AI are widely shared.

In conclusion, AI will probably not cause permanent mass unemployment, but it will change the labour market faster than any previous technology. How well people adapt will depend on the education and support available to them.

note.en: States the plan of the essay.
Draws a parallel between the past and AI.
note.kk: Өткен мен AI арасында параллель жүргізеді.
note.ru: Проводит параллель между прошлым и AI.

note.kk: Ескі машиналар мен AI-ды қарама-қарсы қояды.

note.en: A concession: even if new jobs appear, the problem remains.
note.kk: Мойындау: жаңа орындар пайда болса да, мәселе қалады.
note.ru: Уступка: даже если новые места появятся, проблема останется.

note.en: A conclusion from the position: so retraining is needed.
note.kk: Ұстанымнан шығатын қорытынды: демек, қайта оқыту керек.
note.ru: Вывод из позиции: значит, нужно переобучение.

strengths.en: The farming example makes the optimists’ case verifiable rather than empty.
strengths.kk: Ауыл шаруашылығы мысалы оптимистердің дәлелін жалаң сөз емес, тексерілетін дәлел етеді.
strengths.ru: Пример с сельским хозяйством делает довод оптимистов проверяемым, а не голословным.
strengths.example: When machines replaced most farm workers in the twentieth century

strengths.en: Pessimists are shown with their best argument — this revolution is different — not as alarmists.
strengths.kk: Пессимистер дүрбелең салушылар ретінде емес, ең күшті дәлелімен көрсетілген — «бұл революция басқа».
strengths.ru: Пессимисты показаны с лучшим доводом — «эта революция другая», а не как паникёры.

title.en: The other side at its best

strengths.example: this revolution differs from earlier ones in speed and scope

strengths.en: The “both are right” position is not empty: it leads to a concrete measure.
strengths.kk: «Екі тарап та дұрыс» деген ұстаным бос емес: одан нақты шара туады.
strengths.ru: Позиция «правы обе стороны» не пустая: из неё вытекает конкретная мера.
strengths.example: invest heavily in retraining, particularly for mid-career workers

strengths.en: Whereas and Even if express contrast and concession accurately — Grammatical Range at 8.
strengths.kk: whereas және Even if құрылымдары қарама-қайшылық пен мойындауды қатесіз көрсетеді — Grammatical Range 8.
strengths.ru: Конструкции whereas и Even if показывают контраст и уступку без ошибок — Grammatical Range 8.
strengths.example: Even if new jobs appear, they may require skills that displaced workers do not have

note.en: Introduction: why AI causes both excitement and anxiety, the plan of the essay and a hint of the position.
note.kk: Кіріспе: AI неге әрі қуаныш, әрі алаңдау тудыратыны, эссенің жоспары және ұстанымға меңзеу.
note.ru: Введение: чем AI вызывает и восторг, и тревогу, план эссе и намёк на позицию.

note.en: Optimists: a historical example, new jobs and freedom from routine tasks.
note.kk: Оптимистер: тарихи мысал, жаңа мамандықтар және күнделікті бір сарынды жұмыстан босау.
note.ru: Оптимисты: исторический пример, новые профессии и освобождение от рутины.

note.en: Pessimists: speed, the threat to educated professions and a mismatch of skills and places.
note.kk: Пессимистер: жылдамдық, білімді мамандықтарға қауіп және дағды мен орынның сәйкес келмеуі.
note.ru: Пессимисты: скорость, угроза профессиям с образованием и несовпадение навыков и мест.

note.en: The writer’s view: both sides are partly right, leading to a practical measure — retraining.
note.kk: Өз пікірі: екі тарап та ішінара дұрыс, қорытындысы — іске асатын шара (қайта оқыту).
note.ru: Собственное мнение: правы отчасти обе стороны, и вывод — практическая мера (переобучение).

note.en: Conclusion: a forecast in one sentence and a condition in the next.
note.kk: Қорытынды: бір сөйлемде болжам, екіншісінде шарт.
note.ru: Вывод: прогноз в одном предложении и условие во втором.

document.title: Artificial intelligence and jobs
document.question:
Some people believe that artificial intelligence will create more new jobs than it destroys. Others fear that it will leave millions of people without work.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
